translations.title: 001 科技与医疗
translations.meta: 材料类型：英语六级翻译 整理日期：2026-10-08 真题信息：2026年6月第1套

fields.sourceText: 科技进步使中国的医疗事业得到快速发展。近年来，远程医疗使优质医疗资源惠及更多患者。医学专家可以通过视频为偏远地区患者提供咨询，指导当地医生制定并实施治疗方案。人工智能辅助诊断系统帮助医生识别患者的早期症状，提高诊断准确率。电子健康档案的普及让医生能够快速了解患者病史，避免重复检查。线上医疗咨询平台极大地方便了患者就诊。科技与医疗的深度融合更好地满足了人民的健康需求。
fields.reference:
Scientific and technological advances have led to the rapid development of healthcare in China. In recent years, telemedicine has enabled more patients to benefit from high-quality medical resources. Through video calls, medical experts can provide consultations for patients in remote areas and guide local doctors in developing and carrying out treatment plans. AI-assisted diagnostic systems help doctors identify early symptoms in patients and improve diagnostic accuracy. The widespread use of electronic health records enables doctors to quickly learn about patients' medical histories and avoid repeated examinations. Online medical consultation platforms make it much easier for patients to seek medical care. The deep integration of technology and healthcare helps meet people's healthcare needs more effectively.

这是一份便于学习的参考译文，不要求逐字照搬。中文长句可在保证信息完整的前提下拆开；`healthcare` 在此指医疗服务或医疗卫生事业，并非个人职业。

fields.grammar:
1. `lead to` 后接名词或动名词。 可写 `lead to the development of healthcare` 或 `lead to improving services`，不能写 `lead to develop healthcare`。
2. `enable somebody to do something`。 `enable` 后先接人，再接 `to + 动词原形`：`enable patients to receive care`；不要漏掉 `to`。
3. `help somebody do / to do something`。 两种都对：`help doctors identify symptoms`、`help doctors to identify symptoms`。本句型不用 `help doctors identifying symptoms`。
4. `avoid` 后接名词或动名词。 可写 `avoid repeated examinations` 或 `avoid repeating examinations`，不用 `avoid to repeat examinations`。
5. `make it easier for somebody to do something`。 `it` 不指某个具体东西，而是形式宾语：`Platforms make it easier for patients to seek medical care`。
6. 主谓一致。 `The widespread use of electronic health records enables doctors...` 的中心词是单数 `use`，所以用 `enables`；不能被后面的复数 `records` 带偏。
7. `medical career` 与 `healthcare` 不能混用。 `medical career` 指一个人的从医职业生涯；“中国的医疗事业”宜译为 `healthcare in China` 或 `China's healthcare system`。
8. 写作与翻译报告分不能从这里拆开。 本文仅用于语言练习；短语掌握情况要靠自己的译句和作文验证，不根据单篇练习推断考试分数。
9. 长中文句可以拆成多个英文句子。 先保留主干和逻辑，再决定分句；例如“专家提供咨询，指导医生制定方案”可以写成两个短句，避免一个英文句子塞入过多动作。
10. 词形和所有格。 `diagnose`（动词）、`diagnosis`（名词）、`diagnostic`（形容词）；`accurate`（形容词）、`accuracy`（名词）。多名患者各自的病史可写 `patients' medical histories`。

translations.title: 002 电子商务助力乡村振兴
translations.meta: 材料编号：002 材料类型：英语六级翻译 整理日期：2026-10-15 真题信息：2026年6月大学英语六级考试翻译（第2套） 分类：数字经济；乡村振兴；电子商务；经济社会发展。 说明：下方译文为学习参考版本，不是唯一正确答案。

exam.label: 2026年6月大学英语六级考试翻译（第2套

fields.sourceText: 电子商务的蓬勃发展正在深刻改变中国农村的面貌。随着互联网和物流网络快速向农村延伸，越来越多的农村居民通过电子商务平台将农产品直接销售给城市消费者。近年来，直播带货（live-streaming commerce）使城乡消费者能够与卖家实时互动，已成为促进农村发展的一种新方式。电子商务打破了城乡之间的信息壁垒，拓宽了农产品销售渠道，帮助农村居民增收致富。数字经济与乡村振兴的深度融合，正在为中国农村发展注入前所未有的活力。
fields.reference:
The rapid development of e-commerce is profoundly changing the landscape of rural China.

With the rapid expansion of the Internet and logistics networks into rural areas, more and more rural residents sell agricultural products directly to urban consumers through e-commerce platforms.

In recent years, live-streaming commerce has enabled urban and rural consumers to interact with sellers in real time and has become a new way to promote rural development.

E-commerce breaks down information barriers between urban and rural areas, expands sales channels for agricultural products, and helps rural residents increase their income and improve their living standards.

The deep integration of the digital economy and rural revitalization is injecting unprecedented vitality into the development of rural China.

| communicate in time | interact in real time | `in time` 表示及时、来得及；`in real time` 表示实时；描述互动可用 interact with。 | Buyers can interact with sellers in real time. |

translations.title: 003 中国无人机产业发展
translations.meta: 材料编号：003 材料类型：英语六级翻译 学习日期：2026-10-13 真题信息：2026年6月大学英语六级考试翻译（第3套） 分类：科技发展；人工智能与智能设备；产业创新；经济社会发展。 材料来源：用户提供的中文原文、参考译文及六个个人易错片段。下面整理语言用法，不添加出口数量、产业数据或考试评分。

exam.label: 2026年6月大学英语六级考试翻译（第3套

fields.sourceText:
近年来，中国无人机产业蓬勃发展，出口量跃升为全球第一。

中国的无人机以出色的稳定性、高清拍摄能力和便捷的操作，受到全球消费者的喜爱，在民用领域得到广泛应用。

无人机已被国家纳入战略性新兴产业，逐步成为能满足多种场景需求的智能助手。

在农村，无人机可精准识别农作物病虫害，高效喷洒农药。

在城市，无人机可快速运送生鲜食品。

在不久的将来，无人机能够在更多领域实现其独特价值，为经济社会发展注入新动能。
fields.reference:
In recent years, China's drone industry has experienced rapid growth, and the country has risen to first place worldwide in terms of drone export volume.

Chinese drones are popular with consumers worldwide because of their excellent stability, high-definition imaging capabilities, and ease of use. They are widely used in civilian applications.

The drone industry has been designated as a strategic emerging industry by the Chinese government. Drones are gradually becoming intelligent assistants that can meet the needs of users in different settings.

In rural areas, drones can accurately identify crop diseases and pests and efficiently spray pesticides.

In cities, drones can quickly deliver fresh food.

In the near future, drones will be able to demonstrate their unique value in more fields and inject new momentum into economic and social development.

检查与调整说明：

- 所给译文整体语法正确。`now ranks first` 表示目前排名第一；改为 `has risen to first place`，更明确对应“跃升”。`rise–rose–risen`，此处用 `has risen`。
- 将产业定位和无人机用途拆成两句，便于掌握主干和介绍信息；`has been designated as` 的被动结构保留。
- `meet the needs of different scenarios` 可以理解，但 `meet the needs of users in different settings` 更自然：需求属于使用者，不同应用情境用 `settings` 表达。这里补明隐含对象，不增加新的事实。`different scenarios` 也可用于描述应用情境。

sections.heading: 中文原文
sections.text:
近年来，中国无人机产业蓬勃发展，出口量跃升为全球第一。

中国的无人机以出色的稳定性、高清拍摄能力和便捷的操作，受到全球消费者的喜爱，在民用领域得到广泛应用。

无人机已被国家纳入战略性新兴产业，逐步成为能满足多种场景需求的智能助手。

在农村，无人机可精准识别农作物病虫害，高效喷洒农药。

在城市，无人机可快速运送生鲜食品。

在不久的将来，无人机能够在更多领域实现其独特价值，为经济社会发展注入新动能。

sections.heading: 学习参考译文（基于所给版本轻度调整）
sections.text:
In recent years, China's drone industry has experienced rapid growth, and the country has risen to first place worldwide in terms of drone export volume.

Chinese drones are popular with consumers worldwide because of their excellent stability, high-definition imaging capabilities, and ease of use. They are widely used in civilian applications.

The drone industry has been designated as a strategic emerging industry by the Chinese government. Drones are gradually becoming intelligent assistants that can meet the needs of users in different settings.

In rural areas, drones can accurately identify crop diseases and pests and efficiently spray pesticides.

In cities, drones can quickly deliver fresh food.

In the near future, drones will be able to demonstrate their unique value in more fields and inject new momentum into economic and social development.

检查与调整说明：

- 所给译文整体语法正确。`now ranks first` 表示目前排名第一；改为 `has risen to first place`，更明确对应“跃升”。`rise–rose–risen`，此处用 `has risen`。
- 将产业定位和无人机用途拆成两句，便于掌握主干和介绍信息；`has been designated as` 的被动结构保留。
- `meet the needs of different scenarios` 可以理解，但 `meet the needs of users in different settings` 更自然：需求属于使用者，不同应用情境用 `settings` 表达。这里补明隐含对象，不增加新的事实。`different scenarios` 也可用于描述应用情境。
- “病虫害”用 `crop diseases and pests`；“生鲜食品”可用 `fresh food`。`export volume` 是出口量，不与表示出口额的 `export value` 混用。
- `e-commerce` 没有出现在原文或译文中，按本次要求作为与配送、数字经济有关的拓展词收录，不补进原译文。

| rapidly development | rapid development / develop rapidly | rapid 是形容词，修饰名词 development；rapidly 是副词，修饰动词 develop。不能用 rapidly 直接修饰 development。 | Digital technology supports rapid development.
The digital economy is developing rapidly. |

对照练习提醒：先找主语和谓语，再检查连接词、可数名词复数、词性与时态。单数 `industry` 用 `has experienced / has been designated`；复数 `drones` 用 `are becoming / are used`。`will be able to + 动词原形` 表示未来能力，不写 `will can`。这些是本篇补充提醒，不冒充额外发现的个人错误。

sections.heading: 本篇必背表达（10项）
sections.text:
1. in recent years（近年来）
2. experience rapid growth（经历快速发展）
3. drone / the drone industry（无人机／无人机产业）
4. be popular with... because of...（因……受到……欢迎；because of 后接名词短语）
5. be widely used in...（被广泛用于……）
6. be designated as...（被列为……）
7. meet the needs of...（满足……的需求）
8. accurately identify...（准确识别……）
9. inject new momentum into...（为……注入新动能）
10. economic and social development（经济社会发展）

先遮住英文回忆含义与结构，再各写一个简单新句；农药、成像等主题词可在这10项之后复习。

sections.heading: 个人语法薄弱点
sections.text:
- 连接词与介词结构：分清 because + 从句、because of + 名词短语。
- 可数名词与泛指：drone/drones、assistant/assistants、scene/scenes、capability/capabilities；区别泛指产品与特定单个对象。
- 词性搭配：rapid development 与 develop rapidly；accurate identification 与 accurately identify；efficient service 与 work efficiently。
- 时态、被动与主谓一致：按语境使用 has/have experienced、has/have been designated、is/are becoming，不把副词当谓语。
- 定语从句与句子主干：用 that can... 修饰 assistants；不在一个主干中无连接地堆两个谓语。

以上是根据已提供片段安排的巩固方向，不能据此认定每项都是长期弱项；后续以独立译句和复盘记录判断。

sections.heading: 巩固练习（5道，先独立完成）
sections.text:
状态：尚未完成；题目与参考答案分开。不要先展开答案。

1. 近年来，我国的数字经济快速发展，为小企业创造了更多机会。
2. 线上学习平台因操作方便受到学生欢迎，并在教育领域得到广泛应用。
3. 这片森林已被列为保护区，也能满足当地居民的休闲需求。
4. 人工智能可以准确识别设备故障，并提高生产效率。
5. 在不久的将来，数字服务将为乡村旅游注入新动能。

<details>
<summary>参考答案与检查点（完成题目后再展开）</summary>

1. In recent years, China's digital economy has experienced rapid growth and created more opportunities for small businesses.
 检查：`has` 后两个过去分词并列，`experienced` 与 `created` 都受 `has` 支配。
2. Online learning platforms are popular with students because of their ease of use and are widely used in education.
 检查：复数主语配 `are`；`because of` 后是名词短语；并列的第二个谓语是被动结构。
3. The forest has been designated as a protected area and can also meet the needs of local residents for recreation.
 检查：`has been designated as`；`meet the needs of + 人群`；`for recreation` 说明需求方面。
4. AI can accurately identify equipment faults and improve production efficiency.
 检查：`accurately` 修饰 `identify`；`can` 后 `identify`、`improve` 都用原形。
5. In the near future, digital services will inject new momentum into rural tourism.
 检查：未来状语与 `will`；`inject ... into ...` 不漏 `into`。

参考答案不唯一，重点检查原意完整、搭配自然和句子结构；本次没有记录任何练习已完成或已掌握。

</details>

translations.title: 004｜2024年6月第1套｜中国传统婚礼习俗
translations.meta: 材料类型：英语六级翻译 学习日期：2026-10-20 材料来源：本次提供的中文原文、参考译文及五句个人练习记录。

fields.sourceText:
中国的传统婚礼习俗历史悠久，从周朝开始就逐渐形成了一套完整的婚礼仪式，有些一直沿用至今。

如今的中式婚礼习俗已有很大变化，但婚礼庆典仍然十分隆重。

婚礼场地经过精心装饰，以象征喜庆（jubilance）的红色为主色调，摆放着许多祝愿新人幸福的物件。

在婚礼上，新人要拜天地（bow to Heaven and Earth）、拜父母和相互对拜，然后设宴招待宾客，并向宾客敬酒致谢。

今天，许多年轻人依然钟情于传统的中式婚礼，体验独特而美好的中国式浪漫。

| 2 | 如今的中式婚礼习俗已有很大变化，但婚礼庆典仍然十分隆重。 | Nowadays, Chinese wedding customs have undergone great changes, but wedding celebrations remain grand. |
| 3 | 婚礼场地经过精心装饰，以象征喜庆（jubilance）的红色为主色调，摆放着许多祝愿新人幸福的物件。 | The wedding venue is carefully decorated, with red as the main color. Red symbolizes jubilance, and many objects are placed around the venue to convey good wishes for the newlyweds. |
| 4 | 在婚礼上，新人要拜天地（bow to Heaven and Earth）、拜父母和相互对拜，然后设宴招待宾客，并向宾客敬酒致谢。 | At the wedding, the newlyweds bow to Heaven and Earth, to their parents, and then to each other. Afterward, they hold a banquet for the guests and propose a toast to them to express their gratitude. |

sections.heading: 我的原始翻译与修改
sections.text:
第3句只提供原始表达片段，不将这些片段拼成未经提供的完整原句。

| 句 | 本人原始表达或片段 | 修改示例 | 核心说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Chinese traditional wedding customs have a long history and gradually developed a complete set of wedding rituals since the Zhou Dynasty. | Traditional Chinese wedding customs have a long history. A complete set of wedding rituals gradually took shape beginning in the Zhou Dynasty, and some of these rituals are still practiced today. | 调整形容词顺序和时间结构；将“仪式逐渐形成”说清，并补回沿用至今的信息。 |
| 2 | Nowadays, Chinese wedding customs have made a big change, but the celebration of wedding remains grand. | Nowadays, Chinese wedding customs have undergone great changes, but wedding celebrations remain grand. | 原句已尝试现在完成时；`celebration` 与 `remains` 原本一致。主要改进搭配和自然度，改成复数后用 `remain`。 |
| 3 | is decorated carefully；the main color is the red；red that symbolized jubilance；many objects were lied；the good wishes of newlyweds | The wedding venue is carefully decorated, with red as the main color. Red symbolizes jubilance, and many objects are placed around the venue to convey good wishes for the newlyweds. | 保留所给片段，分别处理副词位置、冠词、一般象征意义、被动表达及 `wishes for`；完整句子的连接要避免逗号拼接。 |
| 4 | At the wedding, the newlyweds need to bow to Heaven and Earth, and then bow to their parents. Lastly, they bow to each other and propose a toast to the guests to express their gratitude. | At the wedding, the newlyweds bow to Heaven and Earth, to their parents, and then to each other. | 5 | Today, many young people still be fond of the tradition Chinese weddings, experienced the unique and beautiful Chinese-style romance. | Today, many young people are still fond of traditional Chinese weddings, which allow them to experience the unique beauty of Chinese-style romance. | 补 `are`，用形容词 `traditional`，泛指时去掉 `the`，并让谓语时态一致。 |

sections.heading: 个人易错点（七类、18条问题或优化点）
sections.text:
以下只依据本次提供的原始句子或片段；“自然度”表示原表达可理解或语法可成立，不冒充为语法错误。

| 类别 | 句 | 原始片段／实际问题 | 性质 | 修改与原因 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A 时态与主谓一致 | 1 | developed ... since the Zhou Dynasty | 语法/时态 | 改为 took shape beginning in the Zhou Dynasty；若强调持续至今，需用与 since 适配的完成时。 |
| A 时态与主谓一致 | 3 | red that symbolized jubilance | 语境/时态 | 陈述一般象征意义用 Red symbolizes jubilance；过去时并非一概错误，要看语境。 |
| A 时态与主谓一致 | 5 | still be fond of | 语法/谓语 | 写成 are still fond of；复数主语 many young people 对应用 are。 |
| A 时态与主谓一致 | 5 | experienced | 语法/并列时态 | 描述当下习俗用 experience，和 are still fond of 保持时态一致。 |
| B 名词与形容词 | 1 | Chinese traditional wedding customs | 自然度 | 传统中式婚礼习俗通常写 traditional Chinese wedding customs；原词序并非绝对语法错误。 |
| B 名词与形容词 | 5 | tradition Chinese weddings | 词性错误 | 用形容词 traditional 修饰 Chinese weddings。 |
| C 冠词 | 3 | the red | 冠词错误 | 泛指颜色直接用 red：with red as the main color。 |
| C 冠词 | 5 | the tradition Chinese weddings | 冠词/泛指 | 泛指一类婚礼写 traditional Chinese weddings，不加 the。 |
| D 搭配与介词 | 2 | have made a big change | 自然度 | 此处用 have undergone great changes 或 have changed greatly 更自然；原句已正确尝试现在完成时。 |
| D 搭配与介词 | 2 | the celebration of wedding | 自然度 | 换成 wedding celebrations；原单数主语与 remains 在语法上匹配，改成复数后须用 remain。 |
| D 搭配与介词 | 3 | is decorated carefully | 自然度 | is carefully decorated 更常见；原表达并非语法错误。 |
| D 搭配与介词 | 3 | the good wishes of newlyweds | 介词/含义 | 写成 good wishes for the newlyweds，表示“给新人的祝福”。 |
| E 被动语态 | 3 | many objects were lied | 动词/被动错误 | 表示物件“被摆放”，用 are placed；lie 不是“摆放某物”。 |
| F 信息遗漏 | 1 | 未表达“有些一直沿用至今” | 信息缺失 | 补 some of these rituals are still practiced today。 |

fields.sourceText:
1. 中国盛产竹子，是最早开发利用竹资源的国家。
2. 竹子在中国分布广泛，品种丰富。
3. 竹子实用性强，用于生产和生活的许多方面，如筷子、桌椅的制作和桥梁、房屋的建造。
4. 中国人爱竹，自古以来就有无数文人以竹为主题，创作了绚丽多彩的文学和绘画作品。
5. 竹子主干（stem）笔直，象征正直的品格。
6. 竹子具有强大的生命力和适应能力，无论环境多么恶劣，都能够顽强生存，因而寓意坚韧不拔的精神。
7. 几千年来，竹子一直被视为中华民族品格的象征。

Bamboo is highly practical and is widely used in production and daily life. For example, it can be used to make chopsticks, tables and chairs, and to build bridges and houses.

Chinese people love bamboo. Since ancient times, countless writers and artists have created splendid literary works and paintings with bamboo as their theme. Bamboo has a straight stem, which symbolizes integrity.

Bamboo possesses strong vitality and adaptability. No matter how harsh the environment is, it can survive tenaciously. Therefore, it symbolizes the spirit of perseverance. For thousands of years, bamboo has been regarded as a symbol of the Chinese nation's character.

sections.heading: 完整学习参考译文
sections.text:
Fans have been popular among Chinese people since ancient times. Nowadays, they are not only used to keep people cool but are also appreciated as works of art. Many fans are beautifully designed and finely crafted. They are decorated with exquisite patterns depicting landscapes, flowers, birds, and human figures. These fans have high artistic value.

Many famous Chinese painters and calligraphers like to write poems and create paintings on fans to show their artistic taste. Fans are often given to others as gifts to express good wishes and sincere feelings.

Nowadays, the practical function of fans has greatly diminished. However, as a cultural symbol and an art form, fans still play an important role in traditional Chinese culture.

表达检查：原译语法整体正确。本版将 `beautiful patterns` 调整为 `exquisite patterns`，将 `paint on fans` 调整为 `create paintings on fans`，并将 `has been greatly reduced` 调整为更自然的 `has greatly diminished`；以上调整均未增加原文信息。

fields.sourceText: 节俭是中华民族的传统美德。在中国古代，生产力低下，先人们深知劳动成果来之不易，因而秉持节俭的理念。到了物质极大丰富的今天，中国人民依然坚持节俭的生活方式，体现了理性消费的生活理念和对劳动的尊重。近年来，中国政府持续加强节约型社会的建设，倡导“光盘行动”，减少食物浪费，提倡简约低碳的生活方式，推进资源循环利用，反对过度消费。节约型社会的建设有力地推动了中国经济的高质量发展。
fields.reference:
Frugality is a traditional virtue of the Chinese nation.

In ancient China, productivity was low, and our ancestors knew that the fruits of labor were hard-earned. Therefore, they valued frugality.

Even today, despite material abundance, Chinese people continue to follow a frugal way of life, reflecting a rational approach to consumption and respect for labor.

In recent years, the Chinese government has continued to advance the building of a resource-conserving society. It promotes the Clean Plate Campaign to reduce food waste, advocates a simple, low-carbon way of life, advances resource recycling, and opposes excessive consumption.

The building of a resource-conserving society has strongly promoted China's high-quality economic development.

表达说明：本版在不改变原意的前提下，将 `belief in rational consumption` 调整为更自然的 `a rational approach to consumption`，并使用 `resource-conserving society` 表达“节约型社会”。`resource-saving society` 也可理解，但前者更适合本篇正式语境。

sections.text:
| 句型结构 | 中文含义 | 本篇应用 | 可迁移例句 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A is a traditional virtue of B. | A是B的传统美德 | Frugality is a traditional virtue of the Chinese nation. | Respect for the elderly is a traditional virtue of Chinese culture. |
| know that + 从句 | 深知…… | Our ancestors knew that the fruits of labor were hard-earned. | Students should know that progress requires continuous effort. |
| the fruits of ... are hard-earned | ……的成果来之不易 | The fruits of labor were hard-earned. | The fruits of scientific research are often hard-earned. |
| despite + 名词，主句 | 尽管……，仍然…… | Despite material abundance, Chinese people continue to follow a frugal way of life. | Despite rapid technological change, reading remains important. |
| continue to + 动词原形 | 持续做…… | The government has continued to advance the building of a resource-conserving society. | Universities continue to improve digital education. |
| 主句，reflecting ... | 主句所述行为体现…… | People follow a frugal way of life, reflecting a rational approach to consumption. | More citizens use public transport, reflecting stronger environmental awareness. |

translations.title: 008｜2016年6月第1套｜科技创新与成果转化
translations.meta:
材料类型：英语六级翻译 整理日期：2026-10-30
 真题信息：2016年6月大学英语六级考试翻译（第1套）
 真题来源：2016年6月六级第1套试卷 主题分类：科技创新；科研投入；产学研合作；市场需求。

fields.exercises:
以下中文根据真题主题与主要信息重新组织，不是原题逐字转录。建议先独立翻译，再对照参考译文，重点检查时态、主谓一致、并列结构和固定搭配。

中国的创新正以空前的速度发展。为了在科技领域尽快追赶并超越发达国家，中国近年来大幅增加了研发投入。中国的大学和研究机构积极开展创新研究，领域包括大数据、生物化学、新能源和机器人。它们还与各地科技园合作，将创新成果商业化。与此同时，中国企业家努力在产品和商业模式创新上走在前列，以满足国内外消费市场不断变化和增长的需求。
fields.reference:
Innovation in China is advancing at an unprecedented pace. In recent years, China has substantially increased its investment in research and development in an effort to catch up with and surpass developed countries in science and technology as soon as possible. Chinese universities and research institutes are actively conducting innovative research in fields such as big data, biochemistry, new energy, and robotics. They also work with science parks across the country to commercialize their innovations. Meanwhile, Chinese entrepreneurs are striving to lead innovation in both products and business models to meet the changing and growing demands of consumer markets at home and abroad.

说明：此译文对应上方改写练习的内容，供语言学习与表达参考；不是官方译文，也不是对原题的逐字翻译。不同译法只要准确、通顺且符合语境，都可以成立。
fields.expressions:
| 英文表达 | 中文含义 | 用法提示与例句 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| innovation | 创新 | 名词；technological innovation（技术创新） |
| advance rapidly | 快速发展 | 描述事物进步；Innovation is advancing rapidly. |
| investment in research | 科研投入 | `investment in + 名词`；也可说 `investment in research and development` |
| continue to grow | 持续增长 | `continue to do`；描述趋势时可用现在完成时 |
| narrow the gap with... | 缩小与……的差距 | `gap` 前常用 `the`；也可用 `close the gap` |
| leading nations | 领先国家 | `leading` 作形容词，表示“领先的” |
| science and technology | 科学技术 | 常见固定表达 |
| research institute | 研究机构 | 复数 `research institutes` |
| conduct research / studies | 开展研究 | `research` 多作不可数名词；`conduct studies` 可数 |
| fields such as... | ……等领域 | `such as` 后接举例内容 |
| biochemistry | 生物化学 | 科技主题词 |
| new energy | 新能源 | 常用表达；上下文需要时也可用 `renewable energy`（可再生能源） |
| work with... | 与……合作／共事 | 说明合作对象；正式语境也可用 `cooperate with` |
| turn...into... | 将……转化为…… | `turn research findings into products` |
| research findings | 研究成果 | `finding` 常用复数指研究发现／成果 |
| commercial product | 商业产品 | `commercialize research findings` 表示使研究成果商业化 |
| business model | 商业模式 | 复数 `business models` |
| respond to... | 回应／应对…… | `to` 是介词，后接名词或动名词 |
| changing needs | 不断变化的需求 | `changing` 作形容词修饰 `needs` |
| at home and abroad | 国内外 | 固定表达，常修饰消费者、市场等 |
fields.grammar:
1. 主谓一致。 `Innovation ... is advancing` 的主语是不可数名词 `innovation`，谓语用单数 `is`。`Universities and research institutes are...` 是复数并列主语，谓语用 `are`。
2. 现在完成时描述持续变化。 `Investment ... has continued to grow in recent years.` 表示过去开始并延续到现在的趋势。若叙述已经结束的特定历史时期，再按语境使用一般过去时。
3. `investment in` 的介词。 表示“对……的投资／投入”用 `investment in + 名词`，不写 `investment on research`。
4. `seek to do`。 `seek` 后接不定式表示“试图／力求做某事”：`seeks to narrow the gap`。第三人称单数一般现在时要加 `s`。
5. `such as` 用于举例。 `fields such as big data and robotics` 中，`such as` 后接名词或名词短语；举例不必把“等”另译为 `etc.`。
6. 并列信息保持平行。 `big data, biochemistry, new energy, and robotics` 都是名词短语；不要将动词形式混入同一并列清单。
7. `work with` 与 `work to` 含义不同。 `work with science parks` 表示与科技园合作；`work to commercialize research` 表示努力使研究商业化。按中文逻辑选择介词。
8. `turn A into B`。 这是“把A转化为B”的常用结构；A、B 通常是名词或名词短语：`turn findings into products`。
9. `respond to` 后接名词或动名词。 这里 `to` 是介词，不是不定式标记：`respond to needs`、`respond to changing demands`。
10. `both A and B`。 A 与 B 尽量使用相同语法形式：`both their products and business models` 均为名词短语。
11. 现在进行时表达当前趋势。 `Businesses are improving...` 强调当前正在发生的变化；若说长期稳定事实，可以根据上下文改用一般现在时。
12. `at home and abroad` 的位置。 常置于名词后作修饰：`consumers at home and abroad`，表示国内外消费者。

3. `investment in` 的介词。 表示“对……的投资／投入”用 `investment in + 名词`，不写 `investment on research`。
4. `seek to do`。 `seek` 后接不定式表示“试图／力求做某事”：`seeks to narrow the gap`。第三人称单数一般现在时要加 `s`。
5. `such as` 用于举例。 `fields such as big data and robotics` 中，`such as` 后接名词或名词短语；举例不必把“等”另译为 `etc.`。
6. 并列信息保持平行。 `big data, biochemistry, new energy, and robotics` 都是名词短语；不要将动词形式混入同一并列清单。
7. `work with` 与 `work to` 含义不同。 `work with science parks` 表示与科技园合作；`work to commercialize research` 表示努力使研究商业化。按中文逻辑选择介词。
8. `turn A into B`。 这是“把A转化为B”的常用结构；A、B 通常是名词或名词短语：`turn findings into products`。
9. `respond to` 后接名词或动名词。 这里 `to` 是介词，不是不定式标记：`respond to needs`、`respond to changing demands`。
10. `both A and B`。 A 与 B 尽量使用相同语法形式：`both their products and business models` 均为名词短语。
11. 现在进行时表达当前趋势。 `Businesses are improving...` 强调当前正在发生的变化；若说长期稳定事实，可以根据上下文改用一般现在时。
12. `at home and abroad` 的位置。 常置于名词后作修饰：`consumers at home and abroad`，表示国内外消费者。

旗袍是一种优雅的中国传统服饰，起源于满族。清代时，它是王室女性穿着的宽松长袍。20世纪20年代，受西方服饰影响，旗袍的款式有所变化，例如袖口变窄、袍身变短。这些变化使女性之美得以更充分地展现。如今，旗袍常出现在世界级时装秀上，也是中国女性出席重要社交聚会时的首选。不少中国新娘会选择旗袍作为结婚礼服。一些有影响力的人士甚至建议将旗袍作为中国女性的民族服饰。
fields.reference:
The qipao is an elegant traditional Chinese dress that originated with the Manchu people. During the Qing Dynasty, it was a loose robe worn by women in the royal family. In the 1920s, Western clothing influenced its design: the cuffs became narrower and the gown became shorter. These changes helped showcase women's beauty more fully. Today, the qipao often appears in world-class fashion shows and is often the first choice for Chinese women attending important social gatherings. Many Chinese brides also wear it as a wedding dress. Some influential people have even suggested adopting the qipao as a national dress for Chinese women.

fields.grammar:
1. `it is important for somebody to do something`。 `it` 是形式主语，后面的不定式说明具体事项：`It is important for residents to protect nature.` 练习本句型时不要漏掉 `for` 或 `to`，不能写 `It is important for residents protect nature.` 原文 `vitally important` 中的 `vitally` 是副词，修饰形容词 `important`；不能改成 `vital important`。

3. `spend` 后面的结构。 `spend time indoors / outdoors` 用地点副词；`spend time in nature` 用介词短语；花时间做事用 `spend time doing something`，不用 `spend time to do something`。`outdoors` 是副词，`outdoor` 是形容词：`spend time outdoors` / `outdoor activities`。
4. `fewer` 与 `less`。 `chances` 是复数可数名词，因此用 `fewer chances`；`time` 在此不可数，因此用 `less time`。不写 `less chances`。
5. `make it necessary to do something`。 与翻译001的 `make it easier for somebody to do something` 共用 `make + it + 形容词 + (for + 人) + to do` 结构；`for + 人` 可按需要省略。`This makes it necessary to bring nature back into our daily lives.` 中 `it` 是形式宾语；`This` 作主语，谓语用 `makes`。
6. `help / allow / encourage / enable` 的区别。 `help somebody do / to do` 两种都可用；`allow / encourage / enable somebody to do` 在这些句型中都保留 `to`。它们分别侧重帮助、许可或提供条件、鼓励、使能够，不能因为中文接近就任意互换。
7. 动名词短语作主语。 `Spending time in nature helps people relax.` 和 `Taking a walk allows them to relax.` 中，整个动作短语通常看作单数，分别用 `helps`、`allows`。原文 `spending time ... can help` 中，情态动词 `can` 后用动词原形。

sections.heading: 用户提供的英文原文
sections.text:
With the trend of urbanization, it is vitally important for city residents to develop a stronger love for nature. As cities grow, many people spend more time indoors and have fewer chances to enjoy the natural world. This makes it necessary to bring nature back into our daily lives.

First, spending time in nature can help people reduce stress. For example, taking a walk in a park after work allows them to relax and forget their worries for a while. Second, a love for nature can encourage residents to protect the environment. People who value green spaces are more likely to save water, reduce waste and take part in activities such as planting trees. These small actions can make cities better places to live.

Therefore, both individuals and local governments should take action. Residents can spend more time outdoors and learn about plants and animals. Meanwhile, governments can build more parks and organize environmental activities. By working together, we can enjoy healthier lives and create greener cities.

Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence: “Faced with growing globalization, students realize that a deep understanding of traditional culture helps cultivate cultural confidence.” You can make comments, cite examples or use your experiences to develop your essay. [三段式写作结构（学习指导，不是个人作文）]
1. 引出主题：先原样写指定开头句，再表明观点。例如：In my opinion, traditional culture plays an important role in helping young people develop a strong sense of cultural identity.
2. 分析原因：其一，学习传统文化有助于建立文化认同：First of all, learning about traditional culture enables students to develop a stronger sense of cultural identity. 其二，了解传统文化有助于跨文化交流：Furthermore, a deep understanding of traditional culture allows students to introduce Chinese culture to people from different countries. 可用传统节日举例：For example, students can introduce traditional Chinese festivals, such as the Spring Festival and the Mid-Autumn Festival, to their foreign friends.
3. 总结建议：回扣观点并提出可行行动。例如：In conclusion, traditional culture is essential to developing cultural confidence. Therefore, students should actively learn about Chinese traditions and share them with the world.

fields.expressions:
下表是本题学习视图；与旧词条重合的表达只在此补充本题用法，不再作为独立的总表新词条。`enable somebody to do something` 已见翻译积累的共用表达。

| 英文表达 | 中文释义 | 用法 | 可复用例句 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| globalization | 全球化 | 不可数名词；`growing globalization` 表示全球化发展。 | Globalization creates new opportunities for cultural exchange. |
| traditional culture | 传统文化 | `traditional` 为形容词，修饰 `culture`。 | Schools can help students learn about traditional culture. |
| cultural confidence | 文化自信 | `cultural` 为形容词；常与 `develop`、`cultivate` 连用。 | Learning local history can strengthen cultural confidence. |
| cultural identity | 文化认同 | 常见搭配 `a sense of cultural identity`。 | Family stories can give children a sense of cultural identity. |
| cultivate | 培养 | 可接 `confidence`、`habits` 等名词。 | Reading can cultivate curiosity in young people. |
| strengthen | 增强 | 可接 `confidence`、`cooperation` 等名词。 | Team projects can strengthen students' communication skills. |
| enable somebody to do something | 使某人能够做某事 | `enable + 宾语 + to + 动词原形`；复用已有跨册表达。 | Digital libraries enable students to access books from home. |
| play an important role in | 在……中发挥重要作用 | `in` 后接名词或动名词。 | Exercise plays an important role in maintaining good health. |
| a deep understanding of | 对……的深入理解 | `understanding` 为名词，后接 `of + 对象`。 | A deep understanding of local needs helps improve public services. |
| introduce A to B | 向B介绍A | `A` 是介绍的事物，`B` 是接受介绍的人。 | Volunteers introduce local history to visitors. |
| cultural exchange | 文化交流 | 可说 `promote cultural exchange`。 | Travel can promote cultural exchange. |
| traditional Chinese festivals | 中国传统节日 | 具体节日举例时可用 `such as`。 | Schools can organize events about traditional Chinese festivals. |

sections.heading: 题目要求与中文理解
sections.text:
Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence: “Faced with growing globalization, students realize that a deep understanding of traditional culture helps cultivate cultural confidence.” You can make comments, cite examples or use your experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.

中文理解：面对日益发展的全球化，学生们意识到，深入理解传统文化有助于培养文化自信。

作答要求：30分钟；150—200词；必须在作文开头原样使用指定英文句子，可发表评论、举例或结合个人经历。指定句应计入全文词数。

sections.heading: 三段式写作结构（学习指导，不是个人作文）
sections.text:
1. 引出主题：先原样写指定开头句，再表明观点。例如：In my opinion, traditional culture plays an important role in helping young people develop a strong sense of cultural identity.
2. 分析原因：其一，学习传统文化有助于建立文化认同：First of all, learning about traditional culture enables students to develop a stronger sense of cultural identity. 其二，了解传统文化有助于跨文化交流：Furthermore, a deep understanding of traditional culture allows students to introduce Chinese culture to people from different countries. 可用传统节日举例：For example, students can introduce traditional Chinese festivals, such as the Spring Festival and the Mid-Autumn Festival, to their foreign friends.
3. 总结建议：回扣观点并提出可行行动。例如：In conclusion, traditional culture is essential to developing cultural confidence. Therefore, students should actively learn about Chinese traditions and share them with the world.

这些句子是可选择的示范素材，写作时应根据论证需要取舍，不能把它们拼接成一篇已完成作文。

sections.heading: 可复用写作句型（8项）
sections.text:
下表是本题的句型应用视图。`Therefore` 和 `enable...to do...` 在旧资料中已有基础用法，此处仅补充新场景；句型可迁移，但不能机械拼接。

| 英文模板 | 中文意思 | 使用场景 | 原创例句 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| In my opinion, ... plays an important role in ... | 我认为……在……中发挥重要作用 | 提出观点 | In my opinion, regular exercise plays an important role in maintaining good health. |
| One important reason is that ... | 一个重要原因是…… | 分析原因 | One important reason is that online courses give rural students more learning opportunities. |
| ... enables somebody to do something. | ……使某人能够做某事 | 说明作用 | Digital tools enable farmers to reach more customers. |
| Furthermore, ... | 此外，…… | 补充论点 | Furthermore, public transport can reduce traffic congestion. |
| For example, ... | 例如，…… | 举例支撑论点 | For example, schools can organize recycling activities. |
| In conclusion, ... | 总之，…… | 收束观点 | In conclusion, reading helps students think more independently. |
| Therefore, students should ... | 因此，学生应当…… | 根据前文提出建议 | Therefore, students should learn to check sources before sharing information. |
| ... is essential to doing something. | ……对做某事至关重要 | 强调必要条件 | Adequate sleep is essential to maintaining good health. |

sections.heading: 写作注意事项
sections.text:
1. 指定开头句必须原样使用；全文控制在150—200词，写作时间30分钟。
2. 优先保证切题、三段结构清楚和逻辑完整，避免为了“高级表达”牺牲语法准确性。
3. 检查主谓一致、时态、冠词和介词；举例应支持论点，避免重复表述相同观点。
4. `be essential to doing something` 中的 `to` 是介词，后接动名词：Traditional culture is essential to developing cultural confidence.

sections.heading: 原创学习参考范文
sections.text:
While striving for the Chinese Dream, young people enjoy more opportunities to realize their self-worth. Social development creates new fields of study, work, and public service, but an opportunity becomes meaningful only when young people prepare themselves to use it responsibly.

Self-worth can be realized through both personal growth and contribution to others. A student may acquire professional knowledge and use it to improve a medical service, develop a useful technology, or solve a problem in a local community. Such work may begin with an ordinary task, yet it becomes valuable when it answers a real need. In the process, young people gain skills, confidence, and a clearer understanding of their social responsibility.

To make good use of present opportunities, young people should continue learning, pay attention to practical problems, and remain willing to cooperate with people from different backgrounds. They also need patience, because meaningful contribution is rarely achieved immediately. When personal goals are connected with the needs of society, individual progress and national development can reinforce each other. This connection gives self-worth a solid foundation in action rather than in empty claims.

sections.heading: 原创学习参考范文
sections.text:
It is believed that teachers can exert a profound influence on their students’ academic pursuit and personal development. This influence extends beyond delivering knowledge. Through questions, feedback, and personal example, teachers can shape how students approach difficulties and understand their own potential.

In academic work, a good teacher does not simply provide answers. Instead, the teacher helps students identify weak reasoning, examine evidence, and become confident enough to ask better questions. A brief but specific comment on an assignment may show a student exactly how to improve. Teachers also influence personal development through the standards they demonstrate. Fairness, patience, and respect in the classroom teach lessons that cannot be measured by an examination alone.

However, influence is not the same as control. Students must decide whether to apply the guidance they receive and take responsibility for their own progress. The most effective teacher therefore creates conditions in which students can think independently and learn from mistakes. When careful guidance is matched by active effort, education can strengthen both academic ability and personal character.

sections.heading: 原创学习参考范文
sections.text:
Living in an increasingly competitive world, college students should better prepare themselves to confront various challenges. Competition is only one part of the situation; rapid technological change, uncertain career paths, and unexpected setbacks also require students to respond with knowledge and resilience.

A strong academic foundation remains essential, but knowledge alone is not enough. Students need transferable abilities such as communication, problem-solving, and learning independently. These abilities can be developed through projects in which participants define a problem, divide responsibilities, and explain their results. Students should also learn to handle failure. Reviewing an unsuccessful attempt calmly is more useful than treating it as proof of personal inadequacy.

Preparation should be gradual and sustainable. Students can choose one demanding task, seek feedback, and improve it over several rounds instead of trying to master everything at once. Cooperation also matters because many real challenges cannot be solved by one person. Finally, adequate rest and exercise protect the energy needed for long-term effort. Well-prepared students are not those who never face difficulty, but those who can learn, adjust, and continue when difficulty appears.

sections.heading: 原创学习参考范文
sections.text:
With the increasing application of AI technology, there is a growing concern that it may negatively impact human creativity. This concern is reasonable when people accept machine-generated answers without questioning or improving them. However, the effect of AI depends largely on how it is used.

If students ask an AI tool to complete every task, they may lose opportunities to struggle with problems, connect ideas, and develop an individual voice. Creativity grows through such effort. Yet AI can also support creative work by offering alternative perspectives, organizing information, or helping users test an early idea. A designer, for example, may compare several suggestions and then create a solution based on personal judgment and real needs.

Therefore, people should treat AI as an assistant rather than a substitute for thought. Before using it, students can form their own questions and initial opinions. Afterwards, they should verify the output, identify weak reasoning, and transform useful information into something original. Used in this way, AI does not remove human creativity; it can provide material that thoughtful users examine, challenge, and reshape.

sections.heading: 原创学习参考范文
sections.text:
As social media is used more and more extensively, there is a growing awareness of the importance of using it properly and responsibly. These platforms make communication convenient and give ordinary people opportunities to share knowledge. At the same time, one careless post can spread false information, invade privacy, or cause unnecessary harm.

Responsible use begins before a user clicks the share button. Information should be checked against reliable sources, especially when it concerns health, safety, or public events. Users should also ask permission before posting another person's photo or private experience. When disagreements arise, criticizing an idea is more constructive than insulting the person who expresses it. Such habits protect both individuals and the quality of online discussion.

Time management is another part of responsible use. Turning off unnecessary notifications and setting limits on recreational browsing can prevent social media from disrupting study and sleep. Platforms should support these efforts through clear rules and effective reporting tools. Social media is neither entirely harmful nor automatically beneficial. Its value depends on informed choices, respect for others, and control over our own attention.

sections.heading: 原创学习参考范文
sections.text:
As requirements for job applications are getting increasingly higher, college students ought to be better prepared for their future career. Preparation involves more than collecting certificates or polishing a résumé. Students need solid knowledge, practical evidence of their abilities, and the capacity to learn when job requirements change.

First, they should understand the foundations of their chosen field instead of memorizing isolated tools. Project work can then turn knowledge into visible results. For example, a student interested in data analysis may clean a real dataset, explain the methods used, and evaluate the reliability of the conclusion. Team projects, internships, and volunteer work can also develop communication, responsibility, and an understanding of workplace expectations.

Career preparation should be focused rather than endless. Students can study several target positions, identify the abilities they share, and choose projects that close important gaps. Feedback from teachers, professionals, and teammates can make this plan more realistic. Since careers develop over time, no graduate can prepare for every future task. What matters is building a strong foundation and demonstrating the ability to keep learning.

sections.heading: 原创学习参考范文
sections.text:
To increase the likelihood of success, one should set realistic goals and work persistently towards them. A realistic goal gives people a clear direction while keeping the task manageable. Instead of promising to master a subject in a week, a student can divide it into smaller objectives and complete one step at a time.

Persistence is equally important because meaningful progress rarely appears overnight. For example, a student preparing for an English test may plan to review vocabulary, practise listening, and analyse mistakes every week. Some days will bring little improvement, but regular effort gradually reveals weaknesses and builds confidence. When a method proves ineffective, persistence should also include reflection and adjustment rather than mechanical repetition.

Therefore, goals and persistence should work together. We can write down specific targets, check our progress regularly, and revise the plan when circumstances change. Small achievements then become evidence that the larger goal is possible. By choosing a practical direction and continuing to act on it, we are more likely to turn ambition into lasting results.

sections.heading: 原创学习参考范文
sections.text:
Nowadays, more and more students have realized the importance of self-discipline in their personal growth. Self-discipline means acting according to a reasonable plan even when no one is watching. It helps students manage limited time and resist distractions that offer immediate pleasure but little long-term value.

Consider a student who wants to improve academic performance while staying healthy. If the student follows a study schedule, puts the phone away during focused work, and exercises regularly, progress becomes easier to maintain. More importantly, self-discipline teaches responsibility. Each completed task shows that choices have consequences, while each failure provides information for improving the next plan. It does not require a perfect record or the rejection of all entertainment.

Students can develop self-discipline by starting with one small habit, such as reviewing notes for twenty minutes each evening. They should track the habit, identify obstacles, and make reasonable adjustments. Over time, repeated responsible choices strengthen confidence and independence. In this sense, self-discipline is not a restriction on personal growth but a practical means of achieving it.

sections.heading: 原创学习参考范文
sections.text:
College provides a great opportunity for students to explore various possibilities and find the right path for themselves. Unlike a fixed route, college life offers courses, projects, clubs, and conversations with people from different backgrounds. These experiences allow students to test interests that were previously only vague ideas.

Exploration becomes valuable when it is connected with reflection. A student interested in data analysis, for instance, may take a statistics course, join a research project, and speak with professionals. Through these activities, the student can discover both enjoyment and areas that require further improvement. An unsuccessful attempt is also useful because it can reveal what kind of work does not match one's strengths or values.

However, exploring possibilities does not mean changing direction without purpose. Students should keep records of what they learn, ask teachers and classmates for honest feedback, and gain practical experience whenever possible. The right path may change as people grow, but informed choices are better than passive decisions. By exploring actively and reflecting carefully, students can leave college with a clearer sense of direction and the ability to adjust it responsibly.

sections.heading: 学习参考范文
sections.text:
The Importance of Digital Literacy and Skills

There is a growing awareness of the importance of digital literacy and skills in today's world. In my opinion, these abilities are essential for students to study effectively and prepare for their future careers.

First of all, digital skills help students obtain information and learn more efficiently. For example, they can use online libraries to find useful materials and attend courses offered by universities around the world. However, students should also learn to judge whether online information is reliable. Otherwise, they may be misled by false or inaccurate content. Furthermore, digital literacy plays an important role in the workplace. As technology develops rapidly, many jobs require employees to use digital tools to communicate, analyze information, and solve problems. Students who master these skills will be better prepared for future challenges. In addition, protecting personal information is another important part of digital literacy. By understanding online risks, students can use the Internet more safely and responsibly.

In conclusion, digital literacy is not only a useful skill but also a necessary ability in modern society. Therefore, universities should provide more practical training, while students should actively improve their digital skills. Only in this way can young people make better use of technology and achieve personal development.

程序字数统计：指定开头句 16 词；其余正文 188 词；全文 204 词。按题目规定排除开头句后，正文符合150—200词要求。词数用英文字母、撇号及连字符识别英文单词，标点不单独计词。

sections.heading: 答案资料定位与写作逻辑
sections.text:
本地答案文件中存在与该题可靠对应的完整参考范文。依据仓库《权利说明与下架政策》，本节不再次整篇复制第三方范文；学习时可通过上方答案链接对照原文。可重点观察范文如何完成以下推进：

1. 回应题目：直接界定“社会实践与课堂学习同等重要”的含义或表明立场，避免只重复题目。
2. 展开论证：用两个层次说明原因、影响或利弊，并为至少一个观点补充具体例子。
3. 回扣主题：提出可执行的行动，或总结该主题对个人、学习、工作或社会的意义。

避免偏题：不要只列口号；每个观点应回答“为什么”或“怎样做”，例子必须服务于中心论点。

writings.meta: 材料类型：六级写作议论文 英文主题：Independent Learning Ability 学习日期：2026-10-25 题目来源：按本次提供的真题图片与题目文字整理。

[真题信息与题目要求]
Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence: “Nowadays, cultivating independent learning ability is becoming increasingly crucial for personal development.” You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words (not including the sentence given).

作答要求：指定开头句必须原样放在正文开头；除该句外正文150—200词；写作时间30分钟。本章收录的是学习参考范文，不是官方范文或个人独立完成的原始作文。

[三段式结构分析]
1. 第一段：引出主题。原样使用指定开头句，再用 In my view, ... 表明观点，说明独立学习能够帮助学生应对新挑战。
2. 第二段：分析作用。先写发现知识缺口、制定目标、选择材料与复盘错误，再说明独立学习在毕业后仍能帮助人们更新知识、适应任务并把握机会；英语听力练习的例子直接服务于第一个论点。
3. 第三段：建议与总结。建议从小而可行的计划开始，持续记录进度、必要时求助、按结果调整方法，并由学校鼓励自主探索，最终将独立学习培养为终身习惯。

sections.heading: 学习参考范文
sections.text:
The Importance of Independent Learning Ability

Nowadays, cultivating independent learning ability is becoming increasingly crucial for personal development. In my view, it helps students respond to new challenges instead of waiting for others to provide every answer.

First, independent learners can identify what they do not understand and find suitable ways to improve. For example, when a student struggles with English listening, they can set a weekly goal, choose reliable materials, and review mistakes after each practice session. This process often makes learning more effective than simply repeating exercises without reflection. Second, the ability to learn independently remains valuable after graduation. New technologies change the skills required at work, so employees need to update their knowledge and adapt to unfamiliar tasks. People who know how to learn are better prepared to solve problems and pursue new opportunities.

To develop this ability, students should start with small, realistic plans. They can track their progress, ask for help when necessary, and adjust their methods according to the results. Schools can also encourage students to explore questions on their own. With steady practice, independent learning can become a lifelong habit that supports both academic progress and personal growth.

程序字数统计：指定开头句12词；其余正文177词；全文189词。统计使用英文字母、撇号和连字符识别英文单词，标题不计入词数。按题目规定排除指定开头句后，正文符合150—200词要求。

sections.heading: 中英文逐句对照（12句）
sections.text:
1. 英文：Nowadays, cultivating independent learning ability is becoming increasingly crucial for personal development.

 中文：如今，培养独立学习能力对个人发展变得越来越重要。

2. 英文：In my view, it helps students respond to new challenges instead of waiting for others to provide every answer.

 中文：我认为，它能帮助学生应对新挑战，而不是等待别人提供所有答案。

3. 英文：First, independent learners can identify what they do not understand and find suitable ways to improve.

 中文：首先，独立学习者能够发现自己不理解的内容，并找到合适的改进方法。

4. 英文：For example, when a student struggles with English listening, they can set a weekly goal, choose reliable materials, and review mistakes after each practice session.

 中文：例如，当学生在英语听力方面遇到困难时，他们可以设定每周目标、选择可靠材料，并在每次练习后复盘错误。

5. 英文：This process often makes learning more effective than simply repeating exercises without reflection.

 中文：与不加反思地重复练习相比，这一过程往往能使学习更加有效。

6. 英文：Second, the ability to learn independently remains valuable after graduation.

 中文：其次，独立学习能力在毕业后仍然很有价值。

7. 英文：New technologies change the skills required at work, so employees need to update their knowledge and adapt to unfamiliar tasks.

 中文：新技术改变了工作所需的技能，因此员工需要更新知识并适应不熟悉的任务。

8. 英文：People who know how to learn are better prepared to solve problems and pursue new opportunities.

 中文：懂得如何学习的人更能做好解决问题和把握新机会的准备。

9. 英文：To develop this ability, students should start with small, realistic plans.

 中文：为了培养这种能力，学生应从小而切实可行的计划开始。

10. 英文：They can track their progress, ask for help when necessary, and adjust their methods according to the results.

 中文：他们可以记录进度，在必要时寻求帮助，并根据结果调整方法。

11. 英文：Schools can also encourage students to explore questions on their own.

 中文：学校也可以鼓励学生自主探索问题。

12. 英文：With steady practice, independent learning can become a lifelong habit that supports both academic progress and personal growth.

 中文：通过持续练习，独立学习可以成为一种终身习惯，促进学业进步和个人成长。

| review mistakes | 复盘错误 | review + 复数名词 | Reviewing mistakes can improve accuracy. | 复盘错误能够提高准确性。 | 优先背 | 写作007 |
| practice session | 一次练习 | 可数名词短语；复数为 practice sessions | She takes notes after each practice session. | 她在每次练习后记笔记。 | 拓展背 | 写作007 |
| without reflection | 不加反思 | without 是介词；后接名词或动名词 | Repeating a task without reflection may waste time. | 不加反思地重复任务可能浪费时间。 | 优先背 | 写作007 |
| remain valuable | 仍然有价值 | remain + 形容词 | Communication skills remain valuable at work. | 沟通技能在工作中仍然很有价值。 | 拓展背 | 写作007 |
| update one's knowledge | 更新某人的知识 | one's 随主语变化 | Workers need to update their knowledge regularly. | 员工需要定期更新知识。 | 优先背 | 写作007 |
| adapt to unfamiliar tasks | 适应不熟悉的任务 | adapt to + 名词；to 是介词 | New employees must adapt to unfamiliar tasks. | 新员工必须适应不熟悉的任务。 | 优先背 | 写作007 |
| be prepared to do something | 为做某事做好准备 | be prepared to + 动词原形；区别于 be prepared for + 名词 | Graduates should be prepared to learn new skills. | 毕业生应做好学习新技能的准备。 | 优先背 | 写作007 |
| pursue new opportunities | 把握／追求新的机会 | pursue 是及物动词，直接接宾语 | Young people should be willing to pursue new opportunities. | 年轻人应愿意把握新的机会。 | 拓展背 | 写作007 |
| realistic plans | 切实可行的计划 | 形容词 + 复数名词 | Realistic plans are easier to follow. | 切实可行的计划更容易执行。 | 优先背 | 写作007 |
| track one's progress | 记录某人的进度 | one's 随主语变化 | A learning diary can help students track their progress. | 学习日志可以帮助学生记录进度。 | 优先背 | 写作007 |
| adjust one's methods | 调整某人的方法 | adjust + 宾语；one's 随主语变化 | Learners should adjust their methods when necessary. | 学习者应在必要时调整方法。 | 优先背 | 写作007 |
| according to the results | 根据结果 | according to + 名词短语 | We can improve the plan according to the results. | 我们可以根据结果改进计划。 | 拓展背 | 写作007 |
| explore questions on one's own | 独立探索问题 | on one's own 表示独自、自主地 | Students need time to explore questions on their own. | 学生需要时间自主探索问题。 | 优先背 | 写作007 |
| with steady practice | 通过持续练习 | with + 名词短语表示条件或方式 | With steady practice, speaking becomes easier. | 通过持续练习，口语会变得更容易。 | 优先背 | 写作007 |
| lifelong habit | 终身习惯 | 可数名词短语 | Reading can become a lifelong habit. | 阅读可以成为一种终身习惯。 | 优先背 | 写作007 |
| academic progress | 学业进步 | 不可数名词短语 | Regular review supports academic progress. | 定期复习有助于学业进步。 | 拓展背 | 写作007 |
| personal growth | 个人成长 | 不可数名词短语 | Volunteering can promote personal growth. | 志愿服务能够促进个人成长。 | 优先背 | 写作007 |

sections.heading: 可复用写作句型（10项）
sections.text:
| 英文结构 | 中文作用 | 语法说明 | 可迁移例句 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ... is becoming increasingly crucial for ... | 表示某事对某个目标越来越重要 | increasingly 修饰形容词 crucial；for 后接名词。 | Environmental awareness is becoming increasingly crucial for sustainable development. |
| In my view, ... helps somebody do something. | 表达个人观点及某事的作用 | help + 人 + 动词原形；也可用 help somebody to do。 | In my view, regular exercise helps people stay healthy. |
| ... can identify what ... and find suitable ways to ... | 表达发现问题并寻找解决方法 | what 引导宾语从句；两个并列谓语保持形式一致。 | Researchers can identify what causes the problem and find suitable ways to solve it. |
| For example, when ..., somebody can ... | 用具体情境支持论点 | when 引导时间或情境从句；例子必须支持前文观点。 | For example, when residents notice waste, they can report it to the community. |
| This process makes ... more effective than ... | 比较两种方法的效果 | make + 宾语 + 形容词；than 前后比较对象须对应。 | This process makes communication more effective than sending unclear messages. |
| As technology develops, ... | 引出技术发展带来的变化 | as + 完整从句在此表示“随着”。 | As technology develops, public services become more convenient. |
| People who ... are better prepared to ... | 使用定语从句说明某类人的优势 | who 修饰 people；be prepared to 后接动词原形。 | People who exercise regularly are better prepared to handle stress. |
| To develop this ability, somebody should ... | 用目的状语提出建议 | 句首不定式表示目的，其逻辑主语应与主句主语一致。 | To develop communication skills, students should join group discussions. |
| ... according to the results. | 表示根据结果调整行动 | according to 后接名词或名词短语。 | Teachers can adjust the lesson according to the results. |
| With steady practice, ... can become ... | 表示通过持续练习形成能力或习惯 | with + 名词短语表示条件或伴随背景。 | With steady practice, public speaking can become less stressful. |

sections.heading: 重点语法提醒
sections.text:
1. help somebody do something 中 help 后可接动词原形，也可接 to do。
2. struggle with 后接名词或动名词；adapt to 中 to 是介词，同样接名词或动名词。
3. People who ... 中 who 引导定语从句；To develop this ability 是目的状语，其逻辑主语应与主句一致。
4. instead of 后接名词、代词或动名词；more effective than 前后的比较内容要保持逻辑一致。
5. be prepared to do something 表示准备做某事；be prepared for something 后接名词，两种结构不要混淆。

sections.heading: 重点可复用句子
sections.text:
以下句子用于学习和迁移，不表示本人已经独立掌握。

| 句子或模板 | 可替换部分 |
| --- | --- |
| ... helps people respond to new challenges instead of waiting for others to provide every answer. | 将主语替换为 Independent learning、Teamwork 或其他能够帮助人们应对问题的事物。 |
| ... can identify what they do not understand and find suitable ways to improve. | 替换主语和 what 从句，也可把 improve 换成具体行动。 |
| This process often makes learning more effective than simply repeating exercises without reflection. | 替换 learning、比较对象及具体过程。 |
| People who know how to learn are better prepared to solve problems and pursue new opportunities. | 替换 who 从句及两个并列动作。 |
| With steady practice, ... can become a lifelong habit that supports both academic progress and personal growth. | 替换习惯、能力以及 both ... and ... 后的两个结果。 |

fields.guidance:
[题目与中文理解]
核心题目／指定开头： The importance of having a sense of community responsibility.

中文理解：围绕“社区责任”说明立场，分析其影响或重要性，并用理由、例子或个人经验展开。

作答要求：30分钟；150—200词。指定句作为正文开头时应计入全文词数；整理时未重新生成范文。
fields.expressions:
| 句型骨架 | 中文含义 | 表达功能 | 使用限制 | 迁移例句及中文 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `community responsibility` | 社区责任 | 点明主题或核心行为 | 注意词性和固定搭配，不直接按中文逐词拼接 | `Community responsibility deserves careful attention.` 该表达可用于准确呈现本题的中心观点。 |
| `take part in community affairs` | 参与社区事务 | 说明结果、目标或行动 | 应说明主体及具体语境，避免空泛使用 | `Practical action is needed to take part in community affairs.` 需要通过实际行动来参与社区事务。 |
| `Only by doing so can we...` | 只有这样，我们才能…… | 总结措施与结果 | `Only`置于句首时主句部分倒装 | `Only by taking consistent action can we achieve lasting progress.` 只有持续行动，才能取得长久进步。 |
fields.exercises:
请用 `community responsibility`、`take part in community affairs` 和一个具体例子写三句连贯英文，分别完成“观点—解释—结果”。

<details>
<summary>参考组织方式</summary>

1. 先用 `community responsibility` 点明主题。
2. 再用 `For example` 补充可核实的学习、生活或工作场景。
3. 最后说明该例子如何帮助人们 `take part in community affairs`。

答案不唯一；检查主谓一致、动词形式、冠词以及例子是否真正支持观点。

sections.heading: 答案资料定位与写作逻辑
sections.text:
本地答案文件中存在与该题可靠对应的完整参考范文。依据仓库《权利说明与下架政策》，本节不再次整篇复制第三方范文；学习时可通过上方答案链接对照原文。可重点观察范文如何完成以下推进：

1. 回应题目：直接界定“社区责任”的含义或表明立场，避免只重复题目。
2. 展开论证：用两个层次说明原因、影响或利弊，并为至少一个观点补充具体例子。
3. 回扣主题：提出可执行的行动，或总结该主题对个人、学习、工作或社会的意义。

避免偏题：不要只列口号；每个观点应回答“为什么”或“怎样做”，例子必须服务于中心论点。

[题目要求概要]
围绕“生活在虚拟世界”展开短文，思考人们越来越多地待在虚拟空间、与现实中的人互动减少时可能产生的影响。作答时间30分钟，要求150—200词。此处为题意概要，完整题目请查看真题来源。

[写作思路]

| --- | --- | --- |
| 第一段 | 引入虚拟世界已融入日常生活，并提出需要关注过度使用的问题 | 在线学习、社交、获取信息都很方便 |

fields.grammar:
1. 让步与转折。 `Although these tools are convenient, ...` 先承认便利，再提出隐忧；使用 `Although` 时，不要再在同一句中加 `but`。
2. 动名词短语作主语。 `Spending too much time ... may weaken...` 中，动名词短语作主语；情态动词 `may` 后接动词原形 `weaken`。
3. `spend time` 的结构。 花时间做事用 `spend time doing`；在某处花时间可用 `spend time in a place`。不写 `spend time to do`。
4. `replace` 的搭配。 `replace A` 表示取代A；`replace A with B` 才表示“用B替换A”。
5. 使役与促使结构。 `allow somebody to do` 保留 `to`；`help somebody (to) do` 两种都可以；`make somebody do` 不加 `to`。
6. `the key is to...`。 `The key is to use technology wisely.` 是常见建议表达，`to` 后接动词原形；`The key is using technology wisely` 也成立。
7. `by` 后接动名词。 `By using digital tools wisely, ...` 中 `by` 是介词，后接 `using`；句首方式状语的逻辑执行者应与主句主语一致。
8. `too much` 与 `too many`。 `time` 是不可数名词，用 `too much time`；可数名词复数用 `too many`，如 `too many messages`。
9. `access` 的固定搭配。 `have access to + 名词` 中的 `to` 是介词，后接名词或动名词，不直接接动词原形。
10. `set limits on`。 `on` 是介词，后接名词或动名词：`set limits on screen time / spending time online`。
11. `put something away` 的语序。 名词可写 `put phones away` 或 `put away the phones`；代词必须放在中间：`put them away`。
12. 并列结构保持一致。 `set limits..., put phones away..., and make room...` 三项都是动词短语，形式平行。
13. `without` 后接名词或动名词。 `without becoming isolated` 中 `without` 是介词；不写 `without become`。
14. 冠词与词性。 `an important part` 中 `important` 以元音音素开头，用 `an`；`excessive` 是形容词，`excessively` 是副词。

sections.heading: 学习参考范文（原创）
sections.text:
Today, the virtual world is an important part of daily life. We study online, keep in touch with friends, and find information with a few clicks. Although these tools are convenient, spending too much time in virtual spaces may weaken our connections with people around us.

One major concern is that online communication cannot fully replace face-to-face interaction. A message may be quick, but it does not always convey tone or emotion. When people constantly look at screens during meals or meetings, they may miss chances to listen carefully and build trust. Excessive screen time can also reduce time for exercise, sleep, and outdoor activities.

However, virtual technology itself is not the problem. It gives people access to education and helps families stay connected across long distances. The key is to use it with purpose. We can set limits on recreational screen time, put phones away when talking with others, and make room for offline activities.

In short, a healthy life requires balance. By using digital tools wisely while protecting real-world relationships, we can enjoy the benefits of the virtual world without becoming isolated from the real one.

范文词数：188词。说明：本文为原创学习参考稿，不是官方范文，也不代表对考生答案的评分。

sections.text:
1. 引出背景： `Today, [主题] has become an important part of [领域/生活].`
2. 承认优点并提出隐忧： `Although [事物] brings us [好处], excessive use of it may [负面影响].`
3. 点明主要问题： `One major concern is that [问题/现象].`
4. 说明影响： `When people [某行为], they may miss chances to [积极行为/结果].`
5. 补充另一影响： `[现象] can also reduce the time available for [活动/需求].`

8. 总结观点： `In short, [主题] requires a balance between [方面A] and [方面B].`
9. 强调合理使用： `By [doing something] wisely, we can [积极结果] without [不利结果].`
10. 总结行动： `Both individuals and [组织/机构] should take action to [目标].`

[题目要求概要]
围绕机器人在工业和日常生活中的使用展开短文，思考随着机器人承担更多原由人类完成的工作，可能带来的影响。作答时间30分钟，要求150—200词。此处为题意概要，完整题目请查看真题来源。

[写作思路]
| 段落 | 内容安排 | 可展开的角度 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 第一段 | 引入机器人应用增加，提出其影响有利有弊 | 工厂、家庭、医疗与公共服务 |

fields.grammar:
1. `no longer` 的位置。 `be no longer limited to...` 中 `no longer` 通常放在 be 动词后、主要成分前；也可写 `no longer do...`。
2. 被动语态。 `are increasingly used` 是一般现在时被动结构，表示机器人正越来越多地被使用；`used` 前需要 be 动词。
3. `as` 引导时间或变化背景。 `As technology improves, ...` 表示“随着技术进步”；从句主语是单数 `technology`，谓语用 `improves`。
4. `take over` 与 `replace`。 `take over tasks` 强调接手任务；`replace people` 强调取代某人。按句意选择，不要写 `replace to people`。

6. `without` 后接动名词。 `without tiring easily` 中 `without` 是介词，后接 `-ing`，不写 `without tire`。
7. 结果与对比。 `As a result` 引出结果；`while` 在本句中对比企业效率与员工工作的变化。避免把仅表示时间的 `while` 误用成因果词。
8. 定语从句。 `work that requires judgment...` 中 `that` 指代不可数名词 `work`，从句谓语用单数 `requires`。
9. `assist` 的搭配。 可写 `assist somebody with something` 或 `assist somebody in doing something`；也可写 `assist somebody to do something`。避免把 `assist` 与 `help` 的结构混为一谈。
10. `leave somebody + 形容词`。 `leave some workers unprepared` 表示“使一些员工处于未准备好的状态”；`unprepared` 是宾语补足语。

sections.heading: 学习参考范文（原创）
sections.text:
Robots are no longer limited to factories; they are increasingly used in homes, hospitals, and public services. As technology improves, they may take over more tasks that people currently perform. This change can bring both benefits and challenges.

On the one hand, robots can handle repetitive, dangerous, or physically demanding work. They can operate in environments unsafe for humans and perform precise tasks without tiring easily. As a result, businesses may become more efficient, while workers can focus on work that requires judgment, creativity, and communication. Robots can also assist older adults and people with disabilities in daily life.

On the other hand, replacing people too quickly may cause job losses and leave some workers unprepared for new roles. Human contact also matters in fields such as education and healthcare, where empathy and trust are essential. Therefore, society should introduce robots responsibly, provide training for workers, and ensure that technology supports rather than simply replaces people. With careful planning, robots can improve our lives while humans remain responsible for decisions that require understanding and compassion.

范文词数：175词。说明：本文为原创学习参考稿，不是官方范文，也不代表对考生答案的评分。

sections.text:
1. 引入变化： `As [technology / society] develops, [change] is becoming increasingly common.`

sections.heading: 答案资料定位与写作逻辑
sections.text:
本地答案文件中存在与该题可靠对应的完整参考范文。依据仓库《权利说明与下架政策》，本节不再次整篇复制第三方范文；学习时可通过上方答案链接对照原文。可重点观察范文如何完成以下推进：

1. 回应题目：直接界定“好习惯源于抵制诱惑”的含义或表明立场，避免只重复题目。
2. 展开论证：用两个层次说明原因、影响或利弊，并为至少一个观点补充具体例子。
3. 回扣主题：提出可执行的行动，或总结该主题对个人、学习、工作或社会的意义。

避免偏题：不要只列口号；每个观点应回答“为什么”或“怎样做”，例子必须服务于中心论点。

sections.text:
任务：为校报投稿，提出丰富学生中国传统文化知识的方法；30 分钟；120—180 词。

sections.heading: 审题与写作逻辑
sections.text: 答案提出课程融入与文化活动两条路径：前者兼顾知识和实践，后者通过节日、食物和表演形成共同文化认同。不能只赞美传统文化而忽略“如何丰富知识”。

misc.heading: 重点词汇
misc.text:
按“翻译xxx／写作xxx”来源标识归档完整词条；词条内所有旧义项和例句保留。表内来源写作001的用法可在写作册查看原材料。

同一行中的斜线表示相关词形，背诵时要分清词性和用法；例句只示范其中最常用的形式。词义均按本篇及可迁移语境解释。

| 单词 | 词性 | 中文含义 | 常见搭配 | 简短例句 | 例句中文 | 背诵优先级 | 来源材料编号 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| advance | n.; v. | 进步；推进 | technological advances | Technological advances improve daily life. | 技术进步改善日常生活。 | 优先背 | 翻译001 |
| develop / development | v. / n. | ①发展、制定；②培养、逐渐形成（写作001新增动词义）；③开发（翻译005）；development：发展、进步 | develop a plan; the development of healthcare; develop a love for nature; economic and social development; develop bamboo resources | Technology supports the development of healthcare.
新增：Children can develop a love for nature.
竹文化：China developed bamboo resources. | 科技促进医疗事业的发展。
新增：孩子们可以培养对自然的热爱。
竹文化：中国开发了竹资源。 | 优先背 | 翻译001、写作001、翻译003、翻译005 |
| enable | v. | 使能够 | enable somebody to do something | Online classes enable students to learn at home.
本篇复现：Live-streaming commerce has enabled consumers to interact with sellers. | 在线课程使学生能够在家学习。
本篇：直播带货使消费者能够与卖家互动。 | 优先背 | 翻译001、翻译002 |
| benefit | v.; n. | 受益；益处 | benefit from something | Many people benefit from online services. | 许多人从线上服务中受益。 | 优先背 | 翻译001 |
| resource | n. | 资源 | educational / medical resources; bamboo resources | Rural schools need better resources.
竹文化：Bamboo is a valuable natural resource. | 乡村学校需要更好的资源。
竹文化：竹子是一种宝贵的自然资源。 | 优先背 | 翻译001、翻译005 |
| remote | adj. | 偏远的 | remote areas | She works in a remote area. | 她在偏远地区工作。 | 拓展背 | 翻译001 |
| consultation | n. | 咨询；问诊 | an online medical consultation | You can book a consultation online. | 你可以在线预约问诊。 | 拓展背 | 翻译001 |
| treatment | n. | 治疗；治疗方案中的“治疗” | a treatment plan | The doctor explained the treatment plan. | 医生解释了治疗方案。 | 拓展背 | 翻译001 |
| telemedicine | n. | 远程医疗 | the use of telemedicine | Telemedicine connects doctors and patients online. | 远程医疗在线连接医生和患者。 | 拓展背 | 翻译001 |
| diagnose / diagnosis / diagnostic | v. / n. / adj. | 诊断；诊断结果或过程；诊断用的 | diagnose a disease; an accurate diagnosis; a diagnostic system | An accurate diagnosis is important. | 准确的诊断很重要。 | 优先背 | 翻译001 |
| symptom | n. | 症状 | early symptoms | A fever can be an early symptom. | 发烧可能是早期症状。 | 拓展背 | 翻译001 |
| accurate / accuracy / accurately | adj. / n. / adv. | 准确的；准确性；accurately：准确地 | an accurate diagnosis; improve accuracy; accurately identify | Practice can improve accuracy.
补充：Drones can accurately identify crop diseases. | 练习可以提高准确性。
补充：无人机可以准确识别农作物疾病。 | 优先背 | 翻译001、翻译003 |
| widespread | adj. | 广泛的；普及的 | the widespread use of something | The widespread use of apps changes daily life. | 应用程序的广泛使用改变了日常生活。 | 优先背 | 翻译001 |
| avoid | v. | 避免 | avoid repeated tests; avoid doing something | We should avoid wasting time. | 我们应避免浪费时间。 | 优先背 | 翻译001 |
| examination | n. | 检查；考试（依语境） | a medical examination; repeated examinations | This medical examination takes ten minutes. | 这项医学检查需要十分钟。 | 拓展背 | 翻译001 |
| integrate / integration | v. / n. | 融合；融合 | integrate A with B; the integration of A and B; deep integration | The integration of technology and education helps students.
本篇复现：The deep integration of the digital economy and rural revitalization is injecting vitality into rural development. | 科技与教育的融合使学生受益。
本篇：数字经济与乡村振兴的深度融合正为农村发展注入活力。 | 优先背 | 翻译001、翻译002 |
| healthcare | n. | 医疗服务；医疗卫生事业 | improve healthcare; healthcare needs | Technology can improve healthcare. | 科技可以改善医疗服务。 | 优先背 | 翻译001 |
| patient | n.; adj. | 患者；有耐心的（本篇取名词义） | patients in remote areas | Doctors listen to patients. | 医生倾听患者的诉求。 | 拓展背 | 翻译001 |
| medical | adj. | 医疗的；医学的 | medical experts; medical resources | Medical experts can help local doctors. | 医学专家可以帮助当地医生。 | 优先背 | 翻译001 |
| e-commerce | n.（通常不可数） | 电子商务 | e-commerce platforms; the growth of e-commerce | E-commerce makes shopping more convenient.
本篇复现：E-commerce breaks down information barriers. | 电子商务让购物更方便。
本篇：电子商务打破信息壁垒。 | 优先背 | 翻译003（拓展）、翻译002 |
| drone | n.（可数） | 无人机 | a drone; the drone industry | Drones help farmers check their crops. | 无人机帮助农民检查农作物。 | 优先背 | 翻译003 |
| stable / stability | adj. / n. | 稳定的；稳定性 | a stable system; improve stability | Better software can improve system stability. | 更好的软件可以提高系统稳定性。 | 优先背 | 翻译003 |
| high-definition | adj. | 高清的 | high-definition images | The camera can take high-definition images. | 这台相机可以拍摄高清图像。 | 拓展背 | 翻译003 |
| gradual / gradually | adj. / adv. | 逐步的；逐渐地 | a gradual change; gradually become | Digital tools are gradually changing daily life. | 数字工具正在逐渐改变日常生活。 | 优先背 | 翻译003 |
| efficient / efficiently / efficiency | adj. / adv. / n. | 高效的；高效地；效率 | an efficient service; work efficiently; improve efficiency | Digital tools help us work efficiently. | 数字工具帮助我们高效工作。 | 优先背 | 翻译003 |
| rapid / rapidly | adj. / adv. | 快速的；快速地 | rapid development; develop rapidly | The service is developing rapidly.
本篇复现：The rapid development of e-commerce is changing rural China. | 这项服务正在快速发展。
本篇：电子商务的快速发展正在改变中国农村。 | 优先背 | 翻译003、翻译002 |
| capability / capabilities | n.（单数／复数） | 能力；功能能力（本篇指成像能力） | imaging capabilities; improve a capability | New tools can improve our research capabilities. | 新工具可以提升我们的研究能力。 | 拓展背 | 翻译003 |
| profoundly change | v. phr. | 深刻改变 | profoundly change the landscape of... | The Internet is profoundly changing the way people communicate. | 互联网正在深刻改变人们的沟通方式。 | 优先背 | 翻译002 |
| landscape | n. | 面貌；整体状况（本篇指农村整体面貌） | the landscape of rural China | New roads have changed the landscape of rural communities. | 新道路改变了乡村社区的面貌。 | 拓展背 | 翻译002 |
| logistics network(s) | n. phr. | 物流网络 | expand logistics networks into rural areas | Better logistics networks connect villages with cities. | 更完善的物流网络把村庄与城市连接起来。 | 优先背 | 翻译002 |
| rural resident(s) | n. phr. | 农村居民 | rural residents sell products online | Online services benefit rural residents. | 线上服务让农村居民受益。 | 优先背 | 翻译002 |
| agricultural product(s) | n. phr. | 农产品 | sell agricultural products to consumers | Local farmers sell agricultural products online. | 当地农民在线销售农产品。 | 优先背 | 翻译002 |
| urban consumer(s) | n. phr. | 城市消费者 | sell directly to urban consumers | The platform connects rural sellers with urban consumers. | 该平台将农村卖家与城市消费者连接起来。 | 拓展背 | 翻译002 |
| e-commerce platform(s) | n. phr. | 电子商务平台 | sell products through e-commerce platforms | Small businesses can reach more buyers through e-commerce platforms. | 小企业可以通过电商平台接触更多买家。 | 优先背 | 翻译002 |
| live-streaming commerce | n. phr. | 直播带货 | live-streaming commerce enables interaction | Live-streaming commerce helps local businesses introduce their products. | 直播带货帮助当地企业介绍产品。 | 优先背 | 翻译002 |
| interact with | v. phr. | 与……互动 | interact with sellers / users | Students can interact with teachers during online classes. | 学生可以在网课中与老师互动。 | 优先背 | 翻译002 |
| in real time | adv. phr. | 实时 | communicate / interact in real time | The app allows users to share information in real time. | 这款应用让用户可以实时分享信息。 | 优先背 | 翻译002 |
| promote rural development | v. phr. | 促进农村发展 | promote rural development | Better transport can promote rural development. | 更好的交通可以促进农村发展。 | 拓展背 | 翻译002 |
| break down information barriers | v. phr. | 打破信息壁垒 | break down barriers between A and B | Online services can break down information barriers. | 线上服务可以打破信息壁垒。 | 优先背 | 翻译002 |
| sales channel(s) | n. phr. | 销售渠道 | expand sales channels | Online platforms provide new sales channels for farmers. | 网络平台为农民提供了新的销售渠道。 | 优先背 | 翻译002 |
| increase one’s income | v. phr. | 增加某人的收入 | help somebody increase their income | New skills can help workers increase their income. | 新技能可以帮助劳动者增加收入。 | 优先背 | 翻译002 |
| improve living standards | v. phr. | 改善生活水平 | improve people’s living standards | Better public services can improve living standards. | 更好的公共服务能够改善生活水平。 | 优先背 | 翻译002 |
| rural revitalization | n. phr. | 乡村振兴 | promote rural revitalization | Digital services can support rural revitalization. | 数字服务可以助力乡村振兴。 | 优先背 | 翻译002 |
| unprecedented | adj. | 前所未有的 | unprecedented change / growth | The new technology has created unprecedented opportunities. | 这项新技术创造了前所未有的机遇。 | 拓展背 | 翻译002 |
| inject vitality into | v. phr. | 为……注入活力 | inject vitality into something | Cultural events can inject vitality into local communities. | 文化活动可以为当地社区注入活力。 | 优先背 | 翻译002 |
| traditional Chinese wedding customs | n. phr. | 中国传统婚礼习俗 | traditional Chinese + wedding customs；形容词顺序 | Traditional Chinese wedding customs vary across regions. | 中国传统婚礼习俗因地区而异。 | 优先背 | 翻译004 |
| have a long history | v. phr. | 历史悠久 | 文化、习俗或机构 + has/have a long history | Chinese calligraphy has a long history. | 中国书法历史悠久。 | 优先背 | 翻译004 |
| the Zhou Dynasty | n. phr. | 周朝 | 朝代名词首字母大写；前用 the | Some wedding rituals date back to the Zhou Dynasty. | 一些婚礼仪式可追溯至周朝。 | 拓展背 | 翻译004 |
| a complete set of | phr. | 一套完整的 | a complete set of + 复数名词或不可数名词 | The course offers a complete set of learning materials. | 这门课程提供一套完整的学习材料。 | 优先背 | 翻译004 |
| wedding rituals | n. phr. | 婚礼仪式 | ritual 为可数名词；一系列仪式用复数 | Some wedding rituals are still practiced today. | 一些婚礼仪式至今仍在沿用。 | 拓展背 | 翻译004 |
| still be practiced today | passive phr. | 沿用至今 | 按主语调整 be：is/are still practiced today | Several local traditions are still practiced today. | 一些地方传统至今仍在沿用。 | 优先背 | 翻译004 |
| undergo great changes | v. phr. | 经历巨大变化 | undergo–underwent–undergone；完成时 have undergone | Public transport has undergone great changes. | 公共交通已发生巨大变化。 | 优先背 | 翻译004 |
| wedding celebrations | n. phr. | 婚礼庆典 | 复数主语常搭配 remain | Wedding celebrations remain important to many families. | 婚礼庆典对许多家庭仍然重要。 | 拓展背 | 翻译004 |
| grand | adj. | 隆重的；盛大的 | remain grand；形容词作表语 | The opening ceremony remained grand despite the rain. | 尽管下雨，开幕式仍然隆重。 | 拓展背 | 翻译004 |
| wedding venue | n. phr. | 婚礼场地 | venue 为可数名词 | The wedding venue is decorated with flowers. | 婚礼场地用鲜花装饰。 | 拓展背 | 翻译004 |
| be carefully decorated | passive phr. | 经过精心装饰 | be + 副词 + 过去分词 | The hall is carefully decorated for the festival. | 大厅为节日经过精心装饰。 | 优先背 | 翻译004 |
| with ... as the main color | phr. | 以……为主色调 | with + 颜色 + as the main color | The poster was designed with green as the main color. | 这张海报以绿色为主色调设计。 | 拓展背 | 翻译004 |
| symbolize jubilance / symbolize integrity | v. phr. | 象征喜庆／象征正直 | 一般文化象征意义常用一般现在时；jubilance 为较少见词，integrity 为常用抽象名词 | In this setting, red symbolizes jubilance.
竹文化：Bamboo symbolizes integrity. | 在这一场合，红色象征喜庆。
竹文化：竹子象征正直。 | 拓展背 | 翻译004、翻译005 |
| newlyweds | n. pl. | 新婚夫妇 | 复数名词；the newlyweds | Guests offered good wishes to the newlyweds. | 宾客向新婚夫妇送上祝福。 | 拓展背 | 翻译004 |
| good wishes | n. phr. | 美好祝愿 | good wishes for + 人；不写 wishes of | The gifts convey good wishes for the newlyweds. | 礼物表达了对新婚夫妇的美好祝愿。 | 优先背 | 翻译004 |
| bow to Heaven and Earth | v. phr. | 拜天地 | bow to + 对象；Heaven and Earth 按题目写法大写 | The newlyweds bow to Heaven and Earth. | 新人拜天地。 | 拓展背 | 翻译004 |
| bow to one's parents | v. phr. | 拜父母 | one's 随主语变化：their parents | The couple bow to their parents. | 新人向父母行礼。 | 拓展背 | 翻译004 |
| bow to each other | v. phr. | 相互对拜 | each other 表示相互 | The newlyweds then bow to each other. | 新人随后相互对拜。 | 拓展背 | 翻译004 |
| hold a banquet | v. phr. | 设宴 | hold a banquet for guests | The community holds a banquet for its volunteers. | 社区设宴招待志愿者。 | 拓展背 | 翻译004 |
| propose a toast | v. phr. | 敬酒；提议举杯 | propose a toast to + 人；按场合确定含义 | The host proposed a toast to the guests. | 主人向宾客敬酒。 | 拓展背 | 翻译004 |
| express one's gratitude | v. phr. | 表达感谢 | express gratitude to somebody；one’s 随主语变化 | The students expressed their gratitude to the volunteers. | 学生向志愿者表达感谢。 | 优先背 | 翻译004 |
| be fond of | adj. phr. | 钟情于；喜爱 | be fond of + 名词或动名词；be 随主语变化 | Many students are fond of reading history books. | 许多学生喜欢读历史书。 | 优先背 | 翻译004 |
| Chinese-style romance | n. phr. | 中国式浪漫 | Chinese-style 作复合形容词 | The ceremony shows the beauty of Chinese-style romance. | 仪式展现了中国式浪漫之美。 | 拓展背 | 翻译004 |
| bamboo | n.（泛指时通常不可数） | 竹子 | bamboo resources; bamboo culture | Bamboo grows in many parts of China. | 竹子生长在中国许多地区。 | 优先背 | 翻译005 |
| be rich in | adj. phr. | 富含；盛产 | be rich in + 资源 | The region is rich in cultural resources. | 该地区文化资源丰富。 | 优先背 | 翻译005 |
| develop and utilize | v. phr. | 开发并利用 | develop and utilize resources | Communities can develop and utilize local resources wisely. | 社区可以合理开发利用本地资源。 | 优先背 | 翻译005 |
| one of the earliest ... to do | 结构 | 最早做某事的……之一 | one of the earliest + 复数名词 + to do | This city was one of the earliest places to adopt electric buses. | 这座城市是最早采用电动公交车的地方之一。 | 优先背 | 翻译005 |
| be widely distributed in | v. phr. | 在……广泛分布 | be widely distributed in + 地点 | This plant is widely distributed in southern China. | 这种植物广泛分布于中国南方。 | 优先背 | 翻译005 |
| come in many varieties | v. phr. | 品种繁多 | come in many varieties | Tea comes in many varieties. | 茶有很多品种。 | 优先背 | 翻译005 |
| highly practical | adj. phr. | 实用性很强 | highly + 形容词 | This simple tool is highly practical. | 这个简单的工具非常实用。 | 优先背 | 翻译005 |
| production and daily life | n. phr. | 生产和日常生活 | be used in production and daily life | Digital tools are used in production and daily life. | 数字工具用于生产和日常生活。 | 优先背 | 翻译005 |
| be used to make / build | v. phr. | 被用来制作／建造 | be used to + 动词原形 | Wood can be used to make furniture and build houses. | 木材可用于制作家具和建造房屋。 | 优先背 | 翻译005 |
| chopsticks | n.（复数） | 筷子 | make bamboo chopsticks | Many families use chopsticks every day. | 许多家庭每天使用筷子。 | 拓展背 | 翻译005 |
| since ancient times | 时间短语 | 自古以来 | 常与现在完成时搭配 | Since ancient times, people have valued education. | 自古以来，人们一直重视教育。 | 优先背 | 翻译005 |
| countless writers and artists | n. phr. | 无数文人与艺术家 | countless + 复数名词 | Countless writers and artists have drawn inspiration from nature. | 无数作家和艺术家从自然中获得灵感。 | 拓展背 | 翻译005 |
| literary works and paintings | n. phr. | 文学与绘画作品 | 复数并列名词 | The museum displays literary works and paintings. | 博物馆展出文学和绘画作品。 | 拓展背 | 翻译005 |
| straight stem | n. phr. | 笔直的主干 | a straight stem | This plant has a straight stem. | 这种植物有笔直的主干。 | 拓展背 | 翻译005 |
| integrity | n.（不可数） | 正直；诚信 | symbolize integrity | The leader is known for her integrity. | 这位领导者以正直著称。 | 优先背 | 翻译005 |
| vitality and adaptability | n. phr. | 生命力和适应能力 | possess vitality and adaptability | The species shows strong vitality and adaptability. | 该物种展现出很强的生命力和适应能力。 | 拓展背 | 翻译005 |
| harsh environment | n. phr. | 恶劣的环境 | survive in a harsh environment | Some plants survive in a harsh environment. | 一些植物能在恶劣环境中生存。 | 优先背 | 翻译005 |
| survive tenaciously | v. phr. | 顽强生存 | survive + 副词 | Small plants can survive tenaciously in dry soil. | 小植物能在干燥土壤中顽强生存。 | 拓展背 | 翻译005 |
| spirit of perseverance | n. phr. | 坚韧不拔的精神 | the spirit of perseverance | The story reflects the spirit of perseverance. | 这个故事体现了坚韧不拔的精神。 | 优先背 | 翻译005 |
| be regarded as | v. phr. | 被视为 | be regarded as + 名词短语 | The river is regarded as a symbol of the city. | 这条河被视为这座城市的象征。 | 优先背 | 翻译005 |
| innovation | n. | 创新 | technological innovation; promote innovation | Innovation is advancing rapidly. | 创新正快速发展。 | 优先背 | 翻译008 |
| investment | n. | 投入；投资 | investment in research; increase investment in... | Investment in research has continued to grow. | 科研投入持续增长。 | 优先背 | 翻译008 |
| narrow the gap with... | v. phr. | 缩小与……的差距 | seek to narrow the gap with leading nations | The program seeks to narrow the gap with leading countries. | 该项目力求缩小与领先国家的差距。 | 优先背 | 翻译008 |
| biochemistry | n. | 生物化学 | biochemistry research; the field of biochemistry | Biochemistry is an important research field. | 生物化学是重要的研究领域。 | 拓展背 | 翻译008 |
| research findings | n. phr. | 研究成果 | turn research findings into products | Science parks help turn research findings into products. | 科技园帮助把研究成果转化为产品。 | 优先背 | 翻译008 |
| commercialize | v. | 使商业化 | commercialize research findings | Companies can commercialize useful research findings. | 企业可以使有价值的研究成果商业化。 | 拓展背 | 翻译008 |
| business model | n. phr. | 商业模式 | improve / develop a business model | Businesses are improving their business models. | 企业正在改进商业模式。 | 优先背 | 翻译008 |
| respond to... | v. phr. | 回应；应对 | respond to changing needs | Businesses respond to the changing needs of consumers. | 企业回应消费者不断变化的需求。 | 优先背 | 翻译008 |
| qipao | n.（可数） | 旗袍 | wear a qipao; qipao culture | The qipao is a traditional Chinese dress. | 旗袍是中国传统服饰。 | 优先背 | 翻译009 |
| originate | v. | 起源；发源 | originate in a place; originate with a group | The qipao originated with the Manchu people. | 旗袍起源于满族。 | 优先背 | 翻译009 |
| elegant | adj. | 优雅的 | an elegant traditional dress | The qipao is an elegant traditional dress. | 旗袍是一种优雅的传统服饰。 | 优先背 | 翻译009 |
| robe | n.（可数） | 长袍 | a loose robe; a robe worn by... | It was a loose robe worn by women in the royal family. | 它是王室女性穿着的宽松长袍。 | 拓展背 | 翻译009 |
| the Qing Dynasty | n. phr. | 清代 | during the Qing Dynasty | The garment was worn during the Qing Dynasty. | 这种服饰在清代穿着。 | 优先背 | 翻译009 |
| cuff | n.（可数） | 袖口 | shirt cuffs; cuffs became narrower | The cuffs became narrower. | 袖口变窄了。 | 拓展背 | 翻译009 |
| fashion show | n. phr. | 时装秀 | appear in an international fashion show | The qipao appears in international fashion shows. | 旗袍出现在国际时装秀上。 | 拓展背 | 翻译009 |
| attend | v. | 出席；参加 | attend a gathering; attend an event | She wore a qipao to attend a social gathering. | 她穿着旗袍出席社交聚会。 | 优先背 | 翻译009 |
| influential | adj. | 有影响力的 | influential people; an influential figure | Some influential people supported the proposal. | 一些有影响力的人士支持这项提议。 | 拓展背 | 翻译009 |
| promote A as B | v. phr. | 推广／倡议将A作为B | promote traditional clothing as national dress | Some people promote the qipao as a national dress. | 有人倡议将旗袍推广为民族服饰。 | 优先背 | 翻译009 |
| national dress | n. phr. | 民族服饰 | a national dress for women | The qipao is often viewed as a national dress. | 旗袍常被视为民族服饰。 | 拓展背 | 翻译009 |

易混词形速记：`develop` 是动词，`development` 是名词；`diagnose` 是动词，`diagnosis` 是名词，`diagnostic` 是形容词（如 `diagnostic system`）；`accurate` 是形容词，`accuracy` 是名词。例：`improve diagnostic accuracy`，不能写成 `improve diagnose accurate`。
